source.name: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
source.note: Manufacturing as a whole (NAICS 31-33) in each county: annual averages, private sector, all establishment sizes. county: the five-digit FIPS code. establishments: annual_avg_estabs. employment: annual_avg_emplvl. avgAnnualPay: avg_annual_pay, in dollars. null: withheld by the Bureau (disclosure code N). A county with no row had no private manufacturing establishment. The "unknown or undefined" county of each state (999) is left out.
